comments: Review: first row is one complete four-frame cycle; repeated rows stay unwired. Clamp hot highlights in cache and keep exact danger borders above decoration.
Only existing states are wired. All source rectangles and SHA-256 are retained.

Native iteration: select same-family alternate ignition/peak components where first-cycle highlights fall below 0.90 colour agreement. Every active frame now clears the existing diagnostic; repeated unselected components keep their flags.
geometry: Reported sampled contact point; no extra hit area. Draw above relevant bodies.
mapping_basis: Visual review of source sheet and measured components, 2026-10-15; supplemental poses retained separately.
